libraryLede: Upload and edit files here — alt, purpose, tags, privacy, category, and file replace. Photos become WebP by default. The document store is still Payload until the store move. Pipeline rules:
folderHintLocal: Each category is a folder under media/ (slug path, such as media/logos/events). Drop files there and refresh this page. The uploader saves into the same folders. Image sizes go in _derivatives.
folderHintS3: Each category is a prefix in the bucket (slug path, such as logos/events/file.webp). Uploads and moves use that layout. Image sizes go in _derivatives.
storeNote: Document store is still Payload. Daily edits stay on this page.
privateHint: Hidden from the public library. Form attachments stay private.
noTagsYet: No tags yet. Create one in the sidebar.
replaceHint: Uploads a new file in place and rebuilds image sizes.
fileTypeRejected: That file type is not allowed.
tagFilterEmpty: No tags yet — create one under Tags.
uploadNeedsLabel: Add a short label for this file.
uploadIntro: Drop an image, PDF, Word document, or text file, then add a label. Photos convert to WebP by default. Max edge {maxEdge}px (Media → Settings).
dropTitle: Drop a file here, or choose one
dropHint: Images, PDF, Word, or plain text.
emptyUpload: Upload above to add a file, or pick another folder.
